Custom workflows are live for everyone on the Team plan.

You can now chain any trigger to any sequence of actions. The most common setup in beta was simple: when a ticket gets tagged urgent, post to the on-call channel and assign the duty engineer. Beta teams built 340 workflows in six weeks, and the median one had just two steps.

Rollout happens in waves this week because each workspace needs a one-time migration. You will get an email when yours is ready.

If you built automations with the old rules engine, they keep working until January, then we migrate them for you.
